props.name: load
props.meaning: The read behind the list. Takes the query and the page, answers the rows and `hasMore`.

props.name: query
props.meaning: What the caret holds. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: on_query_change
props.meaning: React: called when the caret changes.

props.name: request
props.meaning: What the read depends on besides the query. A change reads again at once.

props.name: enabled
props.meaning: Nothing is read while this is off.

props.name: reads_empty
props.meaning: An empty query reads too, rather than emptying the list.

props.name: paging
props.meaning: A further page is asked for on a load-more row under the rows.

props.name: debounce_ms
props.meaning: The pause before a typed query is asked for.

props.name: shell
props.meaning: What is drawn around the list.

props.name: command_class
props.meaning: Classes on the command box.

props.name: on_key_down
props.meaning: Keys the wrapper owns, on the command box, with the rows they act on. Spelled `onkeydown` in Svelte.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the dialog is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: title
props.meaning: The dialog's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.meaning: The line under it.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the read answered nothing.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: The accessible name of the skeletons.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of the failed read's own message.

props.name: error_slot
props.meaning: The `data-slot` of the error line.

props.name: loading_slot
props.meaning: The `data-slot` of the skeleton block.

props.name: empty_slot
props.meaning: The `data-slot` of the empty line.

props.name: skeleton_lines
props.meaning: How many rows the skeletons stand in for.

props.name: skeleton_lead
props.meaning: The leading slot of a skeleton row.

slots.name: rows
slots.receives: the rows read, the query and whether a read is in flight
slots.draws: The rows of the list, as items of the command box or as plain rows under a bare shell.

slots.name: empty
slots.draws: Drawn in place of the empty line.

keyboard.does: Moves the highlight, through a load-more page.
Takes the highlighted row, or reads the next page on the load-more row.
With a query, clears it and the rows and keeps the caret in the box. With no query, the shell takes it: a dialog or a popover closes, and the inline box does nothing.
